references.text: The first census of the tribe of Asher counted 41,500 men, compared to 53,400 in this second census, showing significant growth in the tribe.
Here Asher's sons are named as they went down to Egypt: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah, along with their sister Serah. These are the ancestors of the clans listed in Numbers 26:44-46.
Asher's birth is described here when Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, bore him to Jacob. Leah exclaimed, 'How fortunate!' and named him Asher.
The preceding verses list the specific clans of Asher's sons (Imnah, Ishvi, Beriah, Heber, Malkiel and Serah) that this summarizing verse refers to.
